oil1 spring onion, slicedMix the black vinegar, chilli oil and spring onion for dipping.Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan and add the dumplings flat side down until golden.Add the water, cover and steam until the water is gone.Fry one more minute to re-crisp the bottoms and serve with the dip.Fhloston Paradise prawnsGarlic and lime prawn skewers grilled, served on ice with sweet chilli sauceHow to make it16 king prawns2 garlic cloves, crushed1 red chilli, chopped2 limes2 tbsp vegetable oil100ml sweet chilli sauce8 skewersPeel the prawns, leaving the tails on.Toss with the garlic, chilli, zest and juice of one lime and the oil.Thread onto skewers.Grill or griddle on high until pink and charred.Serve on ice with the sweet chilli sauce and wedges of the other lime.Leeloo's sticky soy and honey drumsticksShe eats like she's never eaten beforeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Drumsticks marinated in soy, honey, garlic and ginger, roasted until sticky and lacquered, scattered with sesame seeds and spring onion.Mix 4 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp honey, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 tsp sesame oil.Toss 8 chicken drumsticks in it and marinate 2 hours or overnight.Roast on a lined tray at 200°C for 40 minutes, basting with the marinade twice, until sticky and cooked through.Sprinkle with 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds and 2 sliced spring onions.Chilli salt prawn onions, slicedSlice the pork thin and toss with some of the soy sauce.Prep the cabbage and carrot.Stir-fry the pork in a smoking wok with the oil.Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry briefly.Add the udon, oyster sauce, remaining soy sauce and wine and toss until glossy.Finish with spring onion.Diva's opera night chilli garlic crabThe Fhloston Paradise dinner during the Diva's songHow to make itAs written, serves 4Blue swimmer crabs steamed and cracked, tossed in a wok with garlic, chilli, butter and parsley, served with crusty bread for the juices.Clean 4 blue swimmer crabs, remove the top shells and cut each body in half.Steam for 8 minutes until orange.Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp oil in a wok, add 6 sliced garlic cloves and 2 sliced red chillies and fry 1 minute.Add the crab, a
